\subsection{Run Data for scenario 2: Standard build workflow benchmarks}

% Legend explaining metrics
{\footnotesize
\noindent\textbf{Metrics:} 
Process = benchmark process metrics (time in seconds, memory in MB, CPU in \%); 
System CPU/Memory = system-wide resource usage during benchmark; 
Baseline = idle system state before benchmark; 
Delta = difference between during and baseline; 
Host = hypervisor process metrics (for VM environments only).
}
